methods.label: Check the degree of the unknown
methods.explanation: In a linear equation in one unknown, the degree of the unknown must be 1. In this equation, the degree of \(x\) is 2, so it is not.
methods.levelReason: Recognizing a linear equation by its degree uses Grade 7 definitions only.
